links.why: BRAF-V600E/NRAS-mutant melanoma depends on MEK-ERK signalling; trametinib/cobimetinib approved in BRAF-mutant melanoma
Same MEK1/2 inhibitors as MAP2K1 link (redundant label); BRAF/NRAS-driven MAPK addiction
Only 3 PLK1 inhibitors tested on heme panel, q=0.049; generic antimitotic killing of fast-cycling lymphoma lines
Ewing sarcoma lines are reported to be highly sensitive to Aurora kinase inhibitors; but only 7 lines and Ewing is broadly sensitive to antimitotics
About half of CRC lines are KRAS/BRAF-mutant and MAPK-dependent in vitro (clinical MEKi monotherapy weak due to EGFR feedback)
~90% of PDAC is KRAS-mutant; KRAS-mutant lines depend on MEK-ERK in vitro
Same MEK inhibitors as MAP2K1 link (redundant label); KRAS/BRAF-mutant CRC
Glucocorticoid agonists consistently slow mesothelioma lines (9/10 lines, 16 steroids, specific to this subtype); not textbook, only 10 lines - novel hypothesis
Same MEK inhibitors as MAP2K1 link (redundant label); KRAS-mutant PDAC
Glioma cells depend on mevalonate/cholesterol synthesis; statins are reported to kill glioblastoma lines in vitro (6 statins, 45 lines)
Driven by the same pan-HER/EGFR TKIs (afatinib, dacomitinib); EGFR-family dependence of squamous ESCC, ERBB2 itself likely not the driver

links.why: Driven by pan-HER/EGFR TKIs; EGFR dependence of HNSCC, ERBB2 label is a co-target

links.subtype: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
links.why: EGFR is overexpressed in most HNSCC; cetuximab is approved for HNSCC
Predicted-HDAC1 group is mostly non-HDAC cytotoxics (35/47; e.g. SN-38, doxorubicin, etoposide) with similar effect: reflects Ewing broad chemosensitivity, 9 lines
EGFR amplification/overexpression is common in ESCC (squamous lineage EGFR dependence)
The BCR-ABL1 fusion drives CML; imatinib, dasatinib and nilotinib are approved CML drugs
